title: The least factor of a number at least 2 is prime
statement: For every natural n with 2 <= n, minFac n is prime -- at least 2, and every divisor of it is 1 or itself. Primality is spelled inline, matching this prelude's own convention (it has no Prime predicate).

formal.statement: theorem Nat.min_fac_prime : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat.le (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) x0) -> And (AxNat.le (AxNat.succ (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) (AxNat.minFac x0)) (((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : AxNat.dvd x2 (AxNat.minFac x0)) -> Or (Eq.{1} AxNat x2 (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) (Eq.{1} AxNat x2 (AxNat.minFac x0)))))))

evidence.supports: Nat.min_fac_prime is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo run -q -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example nat_theorem_inventory -- min_fac_prime 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE '^Nat\.min_fac_prime.4.\(\(x0 : AxNat\) -> \(\(x1 : AxNat\.le \(AxNat\.succ \(AxNat\.succ AxNat\.zero\)\) x0\) -> And \(AxNat\.le \(AxNat\.succ \(AxNat\.succ AxNat\.zero\)\) \(AxNat\.minFac x0\)\) \(\(\(x2 : AxNat\) -> \(\(x3 : AxNat\.dvd x2 \(AxNat\.minFac x0\)\) -> Or \(Eq\.\{1\} AxNat x2 \(AxNat\.succ AxNat\.zero\)\) \(Eq\.\{1\} AxNat x2 \(AxNat\.minFac x0\)\)\)\)\)\)\)$')" = 1
evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check. The pattern pins the ARITY and the FULL rendered type, not the theorem's presence: `scripts/new-fact.py` rejected a name-only pattern as population-only, because it catches the row disappearing but not the statement changing inside a row that is still there.

evidence.notes: Reports `nat: axiom=0 opaque=0 quotient=0 total_trusted=0` over the FULL trusted surface (Axiom, Opaque and Quotient), not `Declaration::Axiom` alone, and exits non-zero unless the surface is empty. provenance.source: theorem name and canonical type read directly via nat_theorem_inventory, which prints render_lean of the admitted type; declared by `nat_prelude/min_fac_dvd.rs` (lane nat-factorization).

notes: Primality is spelled inline as `2 <= p` together with `every divisor is 1 or p`, matching `Nat.exists_prime_dvd`'s own convention: this prelude has no `Prime` predicate. Needs no new induction -- it is `min_fac_dvd` plus `min_fac_minimal_of_two_le` plus `Nat.le_of_dvd`. It is about THIS `minFac` and flips no `ml430` mirror, and it says nothing at `n < 2` (where `minFac 0 = 2` happens to be prime and `minFac 1 = 1` is not).
